scope: Bounded, internal BoardlessAI operations only. Queue items cannot authorize market research, external publishing, spending, account changes, credential use, or unreviewed code changes.

items.title: Set today's bounded specialist agendas
items.summary: Review the current operating record and request at most one allowlisted specialist room when a concrete decision or evidence gap needs it. Content-critical service rooms keep their fixed delivery windows.

items.title: Record the deterministic afternoon checkpoint
items.summary: Record completed work and blockers without calling the full council. Do not create a specialist agenda unless the morning decision meeting already authorized it.

items.title: Close the deterministic night checkpoint
items.summary: Reconcile the public record and prepare the daily digest without calling the full council or inventing a new agenda.
